title: Nice bright colors but they smell bad
text: Nice bright colors but they smell bad. These colors are nice and bright! But they smell! As soon as I opened the packaged it was all I could smell. I don't know if its the packaging or the dyes they use but the smell was very strong. I let them air out a little bit and used them anyways. No one complained that they tasted funny.
